name: dsh-yanyan-plugin-aux
description: Yanyan helpers for DeepSeek Harness: per-turn context watermark readings (optionally scoped to specific sessions), three tiered reminders plus an independent long-term-memory tier (each tier turned off by setting its percentage to 0; the compact-soon and nearly-full tiers also have their own reminder checkbox, while the handover tier's checkbox only controls the template file), a periodic clock line, and scheduled session-rotation reminders.

scripts.test: node test/settings.test.mjs && node test/rotate-schedule.test.mjs && node test/handover.test.mjs
